parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: JSON pose overlay for one observed camera frame.
parameters.constraints: At most 3000 UTF-8 bytes. sequence, timestamp, rotation 0...3, and people (0...6 arrays of 17 COCO joints). Each joint is [x,y,confidence], coordinates in 1/10000 image units, confidence 0...1000.

actions.doc: Replace the camera skeleton overlay atomically. Empty people clears previous skeletons. Coordinates describe the upright unmirrored inference image. Does not control physical equipment.
